objective: Capture inbound replies and DMs from social or paid attention so legitimate service interest can become chairman-reviewed invoice requests and confirmed BTC reserve sats.

policy.requiredBoundary: No payment address, exact-sats invoice, paid work, token grant, public commitment, or asset movement before Executive Chairman approval.

replyTemplates.purpose: Ask an inbound lead for the minimum fields required to qualify paid transparency-audit work.
replyTemplates.text: Thanks for reaching out. If you want SATA to review transparency claims, send the project name, token or contract address, public website/X link, and the specific authority, liquidity, reserve, or disclosure claims you want checked. Starter audit is $50. Any exact BTC invoice and payment instructions require Executive Chairman approval first.

replyTemplates.purpose: Acknowledge an invoice request without sending payment instructions.
replyTemplates.text: Got it. I can prepare the scope and exact-sats invoice packet for Executive Chairman approval. Payment instructions are not sent until approved. The work is a public-evidence transparency audit only: no price guarantee, no redemption promise, no investor targeting, and no market-support commitment.

nextAction: When a social reply or DM shows service interest, record the source evidence, send only the intake-fields reply, and wait for chairman review before invoice preparation.
boundary: This queue records inbound interest and compliant replies only. It does not approve invoices, payment instructions, paid work, token grants, custody changes, public commitments, or asset movement.
